text:
Hermes Agent already includes functionality to track and view skill execution history and metrics:

- **View Skill Usage & History:** Run `/insights` in chat or execute the CLI command `hermes insights`. This data is recorded in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`.
- **Call-Chain Tracing & Observability:** For detailed execution logs and tracing, you can enable native Langfuse tracing by running:
  ```bash
  hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse
  ```
  (or toggle it via `hermes tools`).
